_about: Hand-checked map: take-off item -> Karnataka PWD SR 2023-24 item (Vol 1 codes prefixed V1-). factor converts the SOR unit to the take-off unit. Items not listed fall back to text matching with a rate-plausibility check and are always marked for review.

excavation.note: manual, all kinds of soil, depth up to 1.5 m

steel_footing.note: TMT Fe550 for buildings, per tonne -> per kg

mas_plinth.note: burnt clay bricks, CM 1:6, foundation & plinth

fw_found.unpriced: Karnataka SR prices formwork as a percentage of the concrete item (Vol 1, Addendum-I), not as a rate per m² — enter the rate after applying the addendum %
